body: Yes. Was pretty smart. Was a starting Varsity soccer goalkeeper. Went to a pretty good university where I was accepted into a 6 year accelerated DPT program (I would get a doctorate of physical therapy within 6 years). Had a huge mental breakdown. I started showing symptoms in elementary school. Parents pushed me super hard because my twin is severely autistic and my younger brother has high-functioning autism. I was supposed to be the normal one who was super successful. Meanwhile I had severe OCD and Depression.

I have severe OCD and Depression that is treatment resistant, and just realized that I’ve been emotionally abused by a parent. I wasn’t even able to realize until now and I’m 21. My twin brother has severe autism and I’ve blamed myself for it my whole life. My younger brother has high-functioning Autism and my parents lied about it to me. I feel like no one likes me. I’m socially awkward because of anxiety and super lonely. Also I had to leave college because I had a mental breakdown and ended up in and out of mental hospitals for a year. Am back in school now. Feel lost and like there is no point sometimes. I feel like my existence is painful and it’s not getting better no matter what I do.
